d: The threat from Iran has reportedly forced the United States to retreat its military aircraft from the UK. Several CV-22 Ospreys and KC-135 Stratotankers were seen flying out of RAF Mildenhall. OSINT analysts tracking the outgoing flights have revealed that some of the aircraft landed in Scotland, Germany and Spain. Some CV-22 Ospreys have landed at RAF Lakenheath, just a few kilometres away from RAF Mildenhall. Meanwhile, reports state that the aircraft had to flee the British airbase citing threats from Iran.
